name: Rondo
source:
Protagonists sees a mysterious girl in his dreams who reminds him one of the girls in the class. This is a story of his relations with several class girls over a few days.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在梦里看见一名神秘少女，她让他想起班上的某位女生。故事描绘了随后几天里，他与几名同班女生之间的关系。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
